desc: Observe that a subarray’s optimum is the number of maximal consecutive-value components of its distinct-value set.
Express component count by charging every component to its largest present value \(x\) whose successor \(x+1\) is absent, including virtual value \(N+1\).

Derive and validate the O(N) right-endpoint sweep formula: for each R maintain \(S_R=\sum_{x=1}^{N}\max(0,\text{last}[x]-\text{last}[x+1])\) with \(\text{last}[N+1]=0\), prove it equals \(\sum_{L=1}^{R}f(L,R)\), specify the constant-time update of only terms \(x=a-1,a\) when appending \(A_R=a\), and produce the Python implementation.
